## Activity

During October 2025, East City Eye Clinic completed 187 captures. This provides the activity record for the month and confirms the number of captures submitted for review. The service continued to record activity throughout the reporting period, with all 187 captures included in the monthly total.

## Image quality

Of the 187 captures, 5 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 2.7. This figure records the proportion of captures that could not be graded and should be considered alongside the total activity for October 2025. Staff raised no new equipment faults this month.

## Grading

A total of 45 results were graded referable during the month. The median grading wait was 1 day. These figures provide the monthly summary of grading outcomes and turnaround for East City Eye Clinic. The activity, image quality and grading measures should be reviewed together when monitoring the service’s performance for October 2025.
